subject.title: feat(android): add inline dictation to chat composer

question: Should Android permanently replace the visible Voice destination with a Chat-first composer that owns inline dictation and embeds realtime Talk?
rationale: The branch is not merely a UI repair: it adds a user-facing input mode and changes the established navigation and audio-session model for existing Android users.

options.title: Approve the unified Chat design
options.body: Accept Chat as the permanent home for dictation and realtime Talk, with the Voice route normalized to Chat and the tested microphone exclusivity rules retained.

options.title: Keep Voice as a destination
options.body: Retain the dedicated Voice navigation surface and narrow this PR to inline dictation or another approved subset.

options.title: Pause for Android UX direction
options.body: Hold the feature until an Android owner defines the long-term relationship among Chat, voice notes, dictation, and realtime Talk.

recommendation.title: Approve the unified Chat design
recommendation.body: Accept Chat as the permanent home for dictation and realtime Talk, with the Voice route normalized to Chat and the tested microphone exclusivity rules retained.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged Android composer/session work and this branch’s feature history make them the best available routing candidate for the design discussion.
